structure WeightedGraph where
  adj : Array (Array (Nat × Int))

def WeightedGraph.size (g : WeightedGraph) : Nat :=
  g.adj.size

def WeightedGraph.has_edge (g : WeightedGraph) (u v : Nat) (w : Int) : Prop :=

    -- Unique targets (simple graph)
    (∀ p1 p2, p1 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p2 ∈ g.adj.getD u #[] → p1.1 = p2.1 → p1 = p2)

/-- `oLe a b` means `a ≤ b` where `none` is read as `+∞`. -/
def oLe (a b : Option Int) : Prop :=
  ∀ y, b = some y → ∃ x, a = some x ∧ x ≤ y

/-- Boolean version of `oLe`. -/
def oLeB (a b : Option Int) : Bool :=
  match b with
  | none => true
  | some y =>
    match a with
    | none => false
    | some x => decide (x ≤ y)

/-- Keep the better of the current tentative distance and a new candidate. -/
def combineOpt (a : Option Int) (nv : Int) : Option Int :=
  match a with
  | none => some nv
  | some dv => if nv < dv then some nv else some dv

/-- Relax a list of outgoing edges, skipping targets that are already finalized. -/
def relaxList (du : Int) (visited : Nat → Bool) (dist : Nat → Option Int)
    (es : List (Nat × Int)) : Nat → Option Int :=
  match es with
  | [] => dist
  | e :: rest =>
      if visited e.1 then relaxList du visited dist rest
      else
        relaxList du visited
          (fun x => if x = e.1 then combineOpt (dist e.1) (du + e.2) else dist x) rest

/-- Relax all edges leaving `u` (nothing to do if `u` is unreachable so far). -/
def relaxAt (graph : WeightedGraph) (dist : Nat → Option Int) (visited : Nat → Bool)
    (u : Nat) : Nat → Option Int :=
  match dist u with
  | none => dist
  | some du => relaxList du visited dist (graph.adj.getD u #[]).toList

/-- Extract-min: scan the pending list for a node of minimal tentative distance. -/
def selectMin (dist : Nat → Option Int) (l : List Nat) (best : Nat) : Nat :=
  match l with
  | [] => best
  | x :: rest => selectMin dist rest (if oLeB (dist x) (dist best) then x else best)

/-- Main loop: repeatedly extract the closest pending node and relax its edges. -/
def dijkstraLoop (graph : WeightedGraph) :
    Nat → List Nat → (Nat → Option Int) → (Nat → Bool) → (Nat → Option Int)
  | 0, _, dist, _ => dist
  | _ + 1, [], dist, _ => dist
  | fuel + 1, u0 :: rest, dist, visited =>
      dijkstraLoop graph fuel
        ((u0 :: rest).filter (fun x => x != selectMin dist rest u0))
        (relaxAt graph dist
          (fun x => if x = selectMin dist rest u0 then true else visited x)
          (selectMin dist rest u0))
        (fun x => if x = selectMin dist rest u0 then true else visited x)

/-- There is a genuine path from `start` to `x` of total weight `d`. -/
def PathTo (graph : WeightedGraph) (start x : Nat) (d : Int) : Prop :=
  ∃ p, graph.is_path p ∧ p.head? = some start ∧ p.getLast? = some x ∧
    graph.path_has_weight p d

/-- Structural reformulation of `is_path`. -/
def IsPathR (graph : WeightedGraph) : List Nat → Prop
  | [] => False
  | [_] => True
  | a :: b :: rest => (∃ w, graph.has_edge a b w) ∧ IsPathR graph (b :: rest)

/-- Invariant carried through the main loop. -/
def LoopInv (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (dist : Nat → Option Int)
    (visited : Nat → Bool) (remaining : List Nat) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, ¬ (x < graph.size) → dist x = none) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ remaining, visited x = false) ∧
  (∀ x ∈ remaining, x < graph.size) ∧
  (∀ x, x < graph.size → visited x = true ∨ x ∈ remaining) ∧
  (∀ a b, visited a = true → visited b = false → oLe (dist a) (dist b)) ∧
  (∀ u, visited u = true → ∀ pr ∈ (graph.adj.getD u #[]).toList, ∀ du,
      dist u = some du → oLe (dist pr.1) (some (du + pr.2))) ∧
  (∀ x d, dist x = some d → PathTo graph start x d) ∧
  oLe (dist start) (some 0)

/-- What the loop guarantees about its final distance map. -/
def GoodOut (graph : WeightedGraph) (start : Nat) (df : Nat → Option Int) : Prop :=
  (∀ x, ¬ (x < graph.size) → df x = none) ∧
  (∀ u, u < graph.size → ∀ pr ∈ (graph.adj.getD u #[]).toList, ∀ du,
      df u = some du → oLe (df pr.1) (some (du + pr.2))) ∧
  (∀ x d, df x = some d → PathTo graph start x d) ∧
  oLe (df start) (some 0)

variable {graph : WeightedGraph}

/-! ### Basic facts about `oLe` -/

theorem oLe_refl (a : Option Int) : oLe a a := by
  intro y hy; exact ⟨y, hy, le_refl y⟩

theorem oLe_none (a : Option Int) : oLe a none := by
  intro y hy; exact absurd hy (by simp)

theorem oLe_trans {a b c : Option Int} (h1 : oLe a b) (h2 : oLe b c) : oLe a c := by
  intro y hy
  obtain ⟨z, hz, hzy⟩ := h2 y hy
  obtain ⟨x, hx, hxz⟩ := h1 z hz
  exact ⟨x, hx, le_trans hxz hzy⟩

theorem oLe_some {x y : Int} (h : x ≤ y) : oLe (some x) (some y) := by
  intro z hz
  have : y = z := by simpa using hz
  exact ⟨x, rfl, this ▸ h⟩

theorem oLe_dest {a : Option Int} {y : Int} (h : oLe a (some y)) :
    ∃ x, a = some x ∧ x ≤ y := h y rfl

theorem oLe_of_oLeB {a b : Option Int} (h : oLeB a b = true) : oLe a b := by
  intro y hy
  subst hy
  cases a with
  | none => simp [oLeB] at h
  | some x =>
    refine ⟨x, rfl, ?_⟩
    have : decide (x ≤ y) = true := by simpa [oLeB] using h
    exact of_decide_eq_true this

theorem oLe_of_oLeB_false {a b : Option Int} (h : oLeB a b = false) : oLe b a := by
  cases b with
  | none => simp [oLeB] at h
  | some y =>
    cases a with
    | none => exact oLe_none _
    | some x =>
      have : decide (x ≤ y) = false := by simpa [oLeB] using h
      have hx : ¬ (x ≤ y) := of_decide_eq_false this
      exact oLe_some (by omega)

/-! ### `combineOpt` -/

theorem combineOpt_or (a : Option Int) (nv : Int) :
    combineOpt a nv = some nv ∨ combineOpt a nv = a := by
  cases a with
  | none => left; rfl
  | some dv =>
    by_cases h : nv < dv
    · left; simp [combineOpt, h]
    · right; simp [combineOpt, h]

theorem combineOpt_eq_some {a : Option Int} {nv d : Int} (h : combineOpt a nv = some d) :
    d = nv ∨ a = some d := by
  rcases combineOpt_or a nv with h1 | h1
  · left; rw [h1] at h; exact (Option.some.inj h).symm
  · right; rw [h1] at h; exact h

theorem combineOpt_le_old (a : Option Int) (nv : Int) : oLe (combineOpt a nv) a := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact oLe_none _
  | some dv =>
    by_cases h : nv < dv
    · simp only [combineOpt, if_pos h]; exact oLe_some (by omega)
    · simp only [combineOpt, if_neg h]; exact oLe_some (le_refl dv)

theorem combineOpt_le_new (a : Option Int) (nv : Int) : oLe (combineOpt a nv) (some nv) := by
  cases a with
  | none => exact oLe_some (le_refl nv)
  | some dv =>
    by_cases h : nv < dv
    · simp only [combineOpt, if_pos h]; exact oLe_some (le_refl nv)
    · simp only [combineOpt, if_neg h]; exact oLe_some (by omega)

/-! ### `relaxList` -/

theorem relaxList_mono (du : Int) (visited : Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × Int)) (dist : Nat → Option Int) (x : Nat),
      oLe (relaxList du visited dist es x) (dist x) := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil => intro dist x; exact oLe_refl _
  | cons e rest ih =>
    intro dist x
    by_cases hv : visited e.1 = true
    · simp only [relaxList, if_pos hv]
      exact ih dist x
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hv
      simp only [relaxList, hv, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      refine oLe_trans (ih _ x) ?_
      by_cases hx : x = e.1
      · subst hx; simp only [if_pos rfl]; exact combineOpt_le_old _ _
      · simp only [if_neg hx]; exact oLe_refl _

theorem relaxList_visited (du : Int) (visited : Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × Int)) (dist : Nat → Option Int) (x : Nat),
      visited x = true → relaxList du visited dist es x = dist x := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil => intro dist x _; rfl
  | cons e rest ih =>
    intro dist x hx
    by_cases hv : visited e.1 = true
    · simp only [relaxList, if_pos hv]
      exact ih dist x hx
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hv
      simp only [relaxList, hv, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      have hne : x ≠ e.1 := by intro hc; rw [hc] at hx; rw [hv] at hx; exact absurd hx (by simp)
      rw [ih _ x hx]
      simp only [if_neg hne]

theorem relaxList_bound (du : Int) (visited : Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × Int)) (dist : Nat → Option Int) (pr : Nat × Int),
      pr ∈ es → visited pr.1 = false →
      oLe (relaxList du visited dist es pr.1) (some (du + pr.2)) := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil => intro dist pr hpr; simp at hpr
  | cons e rest ih =>
    intro dist pr hpr hvpr
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp hpr with heq | hmem
    · subst heq
      have hv : visited pr.1 = false := hvpr
      simp only [relaxList, hv, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      refine oLe_trans (relaxList_mono du visited rest _ pr.1) ?_
      simp only [if_pos rfl]
      exact combineOpt_le_new _ _
    · by_cases hv : visited e.1 = true
      · simp only [relaxList, if_pos hv]
        exact ih dist pr hmem hvpr
      · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hv
        simp only [relaxList, hv, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
        exact ih _ pr hmem hvpr

theorem relaxList_alt (du : Int) (visited : Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × Int)) (dist : Nat → Option Int) (x : Nat),
      relaxList du visited dist es x = dist x ∨
      ∃ w, (x, w) ∈ es ∧ relaxList du visited dist es x = some (du + w) := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil => intro dist x; left; rfl
  | cons e rest ih =>
    intro dist x
    by_cases hv : visited e.1 = true
    · simp only [relaxList, if_pos hv]
      rcases ih dist x with h | ⟨w, hw, he⟩
      · exact Or.inl h
      · exact Or.inr ⟨w, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw, he⟩
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hv
      simp only [relaxList, hv, Bool.false_eq_true, if_false]
      set dist2 : Nat → Option Int :=
        fun x => if x = e.1 then combineOpt (dist e.1) (du + e.2) else dist x with hd2
      rcases ih dist2 x with h | ⟨w, hw, he⟩
      · rw [h]
        by_cases hx : x = e.1
        · subst hx
          simp only [hd2, if_pos rfl]
          rcases combineOpt_or (dist x) (du + e.2) with h1 | h1
          · exact Or.inr ⟨e.2, by
              refine List.mem_cons.mpr (Or.inl ?_)
              exact Prod.ext rfl rfl, by rw [h1]⟩
          · exact Or.inl h1
        · simp only [hd2, if_neg hx]
          exact Or.inl rfl
      · exact Or.inr ⟨w, List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hw, he⟩

theorem relaxList_good (start u : Nat) (du : Int) (visited : Nat → Bool) :
    ∀ (es : List (Nat × Int)) (dist : Nat → Option Int),
      (∀ pr ∈ es, graph.has_edge u pr.1 pr.2) →
      (∀ x d, dist x = some d → PathTo graph start x d) →
      (∀ z w', graph.has_edge u z w' → PathTo graph start z (du + w')) →
      ∀ x d, relaxList du visited dist es x = some d → PathTo graph start x d := by
  intro es
  induction es with
  | nil => intro dist _ hg _ x d h; exact hg x d h
  | cons e rest ih =>
    intro dist hedges hg hu x d h
    have hrest : ∀ pr ∈ rest, graph.has_edge u pr.1 pr.2 := by
      intro pr hpr; exact hedges pr (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ hpr)
    by_cases hv : visited e.1 = true
    · rw [relaxList, if_pos hv] at h
      exact ih dist hrest hg hu x d h
    · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hv
      rw [relaxList, hv] at h
      simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at h
      refine ih _ hrest ?_ hu x d h
      intro z dz hz
      by_cases hzz : z = e.1
      · subst hzz
        simp only [if_pos rfl] at hz
        rcases combineOpt_eq_some hz with h1 | h1
        · subst h1
          exact hu e.1 e.2 (hedges e (List.mem_cons_self _ _))
        · exact hg z dz h1
      · simp only [if_neg hzz] at hz
        exact hg z dz hz

/-! ### Paths -/

theorem isPathR_of_isPath : ∀ p : List Nat, graph.is_path p → IsPathR graph p := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd h.1 (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil => intro _; trivial
    | cons b t' =>
      intro h
      refine ⟨?_, ih ⟨by simp, ?_⟩⟩
      · have := h.2 0 (by simp)
        simpa using this
      · intro i hi
        have := h.2 (i + 1) (by simp at hi ⊢; omega)
        simpa using this

theorem isPath_of_isPathR : ∀ p : List Nat, IsPathR graph p → graph.is_path p := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd h id
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro _
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      intro i hi; simp at hi
    | cons b t' =>
      intro h
      refine ⟨by simp, ?_⟩
      intro i hi
      cases i with
      | zero => simpa using h.1
      | succ j =>
        have hp := ih h.2
        have := hp.2 j (by simp at hi ⊢; omega)
        simpa using this

theorem exists_weight : ∀ p : List Nat, IsPathR graph p → ∃ d, graph.path_has_weight p d := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro h; exact absurd h id
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil => intro _; exact ⟨0, rfl⟩
    | cons b t' =>
      intro h
      obtain ⟨we, hwe⟩ := h.1
      obtain ⟨wr, hwr⟩ := ih h.2
      exact ⟨we + wr, we, wr, hwe, hwr, rfl⟩

theorem isPathR_append (v : Nat) (w : Int) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (u : Nat), IsPathR graph p → p.getLast? = some u →
      graph.has_edge u v w → IsPathR graph (p ++ [v]) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro u h; exact absurd h id
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro u _ hl he
      have hau : a = u := by simpa using hl
      subst hau
      exact ⟨⟨w, he⟩, trivial⟩
    | cons b t' =>
      intro u hpr hl he
      refine ⟨hpr.1, ih b hpr.2 ?_ he⟩
      simpa using hl

theorem pathWeight_append (v : Nat) (w : Int) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (u : Nat) (d : Int), p.getLast? = some u →
      graph.path_has_weight p d → graph.has_edge u v w →
      graph.path_has_weight (p ++ [v]) (d + w) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro u d h; exact absurd h (by simp)
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro u d hl hw he
      have hau : a = u := by simpa using hl
      have hd : d = 0 := hw
      subst hd; subst hau
      exact ⟨w, 0, he, rfl, by omega⟩
    | cons b t' =>
      intro u d hl hw he
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hsum⟩ := hw
      refine ⟨we, wr + w, hedge, ih b wr ?_ hrest he, by omega⟩
      simpa using hl

theorem pathTo_extend_aux {start u v : Nat} {du w : Int}
    (h : PathTo graph start u du) (he : graph.has_edge u v w) :
    PathTo graph start v (du + w) := by
  obtain ⟨p, hp, hh, hl, hw⟩ := h
  refine ⟨p ++ [v], isPath_of_isPathR _ (isPathR_append v w p u (isPathR_of_isPath p hp) hl he),
    ?_, by simp, pathWeight_append v w p u du hl hw he⟩
  have hne : p ≠ [] := by
    intro hc; subst hc; simp at hh
  cases p with
  | nil => exact absurd rfl hne
  | cons a t => simpa using hh

theorem path_bound (df : Nat → Option Int)
    (hK : ∀ u v w, graph.has_edge u v w → ∀ du, df u = some du →
      oLe (df v) (some (du + w))) :
    ∀ (p : List Nat) (s x : Nat) (ds d : Int), IsPathR graph p → p.head? = some s →
      p.getLast? = some x → graph.path_has_weight p d → df s = some ds →
      oLe (df x) (some (ds + d)) := by
  intro p
  induction p with
  | nil => intro s x ds d h; exact absurd h id
  | cons a t ih =>
    cases t with
    | nil =>
      intro s x ds d _ hh hl hw hs
      have has : a = s := by simpa using hh
      have hax : a = x := by simpa using hl
      have hd : d = 0 := hw
      subst hd
      have hxs : x = s := by rw [← hax, has]
      subst hxs
      rw [hs]
      exact oLe_some (by omega)
    | cons b t' =>
      intro s x ds d hpr hh hl hw hs
      have has : a = s := by simpa using hh
      subst has
      obtain ⟨we, wr, hedge, hrest, hsum⟩ := hw
      obtain ⟨db, hdb, hdble⟩ := oLe_dest (hK a b we hedge ds hs)
      have hih : oLe (df x) (some (db + wr)) :=
        ih b x db wr hpr.2 (by simp) (by simpa using hl) hrest hdb
      exact oLe_trans hih (oLe_some (by omega))

/-! ### `selectMin` -/

theorem selectMin_mem (dist : Nat → Option Int) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (best : Nat), selectMin dist l best ∈ best :: l := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil => intro best; simp [selectMin]
  | cons x rest ih =>
    intro best
    simp only [selectMin]
    have := ih (if oLeB (dist x) (dist best) then x else best)
    rcases List.mem_cons.mp this with h | h
    · by_cases hb : oLeB (dist x) (dist best) = true
      · rw [if_pos hb] at h; subst h; simp
      · simp only [Bool.not_eq_true] at hb
        rw [hb] at h; simp only [Bool.false_eq_true, if_false] at h
        subst h; simp
    · exact List.mem_cons_of_mem _ (List.mem_cons_of_mem _ h)

theorem selectMin_le (dist : Nat → Option Int) :
    ∀ (l : List Nat) (best y : Nat), y ∈ best :: l →
      oLe (dist (selectMin dist l best)) (dist y) := by
  intro l
  induction l with
  | nil =>
    intro best y hy
    have : y = best := by simpa using hy
    subst this
    simp only [selectMin]
    exact oLe_refl _
  | cons x rest ih =>
    intro best y hy
    simp only [selectMin]
